title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
reason: Major regulatory approval for a top-tier crypto firm to operate a national trust bank, a significant adoption milestone.

sources.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.
The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
reason: Significant security breach at a major hardware wallet vendor with specific details on data exposure and policy failures.

sources.summary: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.
